tasks_completed.description: Fixed the seven full happy-app suite failures reported by QA.
tasks_completed.changes: Restored Build/Plan label normalization, Claude permission fallback order, settings default expectations for existing voice fields, and visible agent service-message normalization including global no-turn service notices.
tasks_completed.rationale: QA blocker 1 was full app test failure; these are the direct product/test mismatches behind the failing assertions.

tasks_completed.description: Preserved Codex tool-call-end output/status payloads through session protocol mapping.
tasks_completed.changes: End events now carry non-identity payload fields as JSON output for exec, patch, collab-agent, dynamic, MCP, plan, image, and processor result events; mapper falls back to id when call_id/callId is absent; app normalization infers failed tool-result state from failed status, success=false, nonzero exit/code, or error fields.
tasks_completed.rationale: QA blocker 2 identified result-loss risk before UI rendering. The mapper and app normalizer now keep output/status/error data attached to the matching tool result.

tasks_completed.description: Expanded deterministic coverage for missing non-terminal Codex rows.
tasks_completed.changes: Terminal renderer parses JSON-string protocol payloads; generic inspectable output pretty-prints JSON strings; plan starts preserve structured plan/status data when present; image/view_image labels derive from path basename; tests cover patch/diff, plan/update, multi-tool, MCP/resource, image/view_image, unknown/fallback, service no-turn, failure status, and payload preservation.
tasks_completed.rationale: QA blockers 3 and 4 were incomplete evidence/fixture coverage and file-attachment-not-image ambiguity. The new tests and manifest give QA deterministic dev-only targets without non-UI session creation.

tasks_completed.description: Accounted for pre-existing dirty happy-cli Codex files and avoided unrelated changes.
tasks_completed.changes: This iteration intentionally changed only sessionProtocolMapper.ts and sessionProtocolMapper.test.ts under packages/happy-cli/src/codex. Other dirty happy-cli Codex files were already dirty at task start and are listed in dirty_scope_accounting.
tasks_completed.rationale: QA blocker 5 was scope risk from dirty happy-cli/src/codex files.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A - QA blockers from first Codex rendering QA cycle, not a bisected regression.
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Previous iteration improved visible renderers but left full-suite regressions, insufficient result payload preservation, and missing deterministic fixture coverage for several Codex payload classes.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: This iteration fixes failing assertions, preserves result/status data at protocol boundaries, adds app/mapper tests for each missing matrix class, and documents remaining live QA-only evidence targets.
